    def LargeIndecomposable.IsBGRSLiftSingularPath {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [HasWellDefinedBGRSRayProduct C] {i j : RayVertex (BGRSRayCategory C)} (p : Quiver.Path i j) :
    Prop

    A ray-zero path which can nevertheless have nonzero ordinary composite for some global choice of arrow representatives. On length-two paths (whose arrows are distinct), this is exactly the BGRS notion of a singular path.

        def LargeIndecomposable.HasBGRSSingularPairFactorization (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [HasWellDefinedBGRSRayProduct C] :

        Source-faithful formulation of the BGRS structure theorem: every singular path has a singular length-two subpath. The source proves uniqueness as well, but existence is the only part needed for normalization.
